proof_body:
by
  intro K n _ _ _ _
  have hs : Function.Surjective (Matrix.traceLinearMap n K K) := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty n›
    exact ⟨Matrix.single i i c, by simp⟩
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap n K K)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hs, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self, Module.finrank_matrix] at h
  change Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap n K K)) = _
  simp only [Module.finrank_self, mul_one] at h
  rw [pow_two]
  omega
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (n : Type*) [Field K] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n], Module.finrank K (LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl n K) = Fintype.card n ^ 2 - 1
